quotes.text: 1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?
2. ¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?
1a. ¿En la semana pasada, trabajó por lo menos una hora? (sin contar las tareas de su hogar)

assessments.reasoning: Section VII of the household questionnaire (EPHContinua_CuestHogar.pdf) collects information on who performs most household tasks and who helps with them. However, nowhere in the individual or household questionnaires does the instrument ask whether a person supervises or remains available to care for other household members while performing other activities or when care is not their main activity. Care is mentioned only as a reason for non-work or as household tasks set aside from paid work (e.g., Q1a in EPHContinua_CuestIndividual.pdf), which do not meet the indicator criteria.
